at: Love arrives the way weather does.
alt: At dawn one long ribbon of cloud lowers out of the sky and rests its tip on the summit of a lone jade mountain, which flushes rose where they touch.
scene: Wide painted mountain landscape at first light. The jade-green mountain lies along the horizon like a reclining woman seen in profile: two soft, full, rounded summits, the long dip of a waist, the swell of a hip, pines like loosened hair spilling down one end — plainly rock and forest, but the body is unmistakable. Out of a deep ultramarine #1e4d9c sky one thick, swelling column of white cloud bends down and presses its rounded tip onto the higher summit, like a mouth on skin; where they meet the stone flushes deep rose-violet #c084fc and a ring of warm mist breathes up. Crows burst off the pines. Charged first touch, wanting.

at: He kneels. The cloud kneels with him
alt: Close on the mountainside: mist slides down into a deep mossy ravine between two rounded shoulders of wet rock, and dew trickles down the cleft in silver threads.
scene: Close painted landscape on the flank of the jade mountain, low angle looking straight up a deep, narrow cleft between two full, smooth, rounded shoulders of rock that swell like parted thighs. The cleft is lined with swollen, slick, glistening moss, deep green flushed violet #c084fc at the lips, beads of dew streaming down it in shining wet threads and pooling at the bottom. A thick white column of cloud pushes slowly down into the cleft, filling it, mist curling back out over both rounded shoulders. Pines on the rims arch and tremble. Ultramarine #1e4d9c shadow deep inside, warm gold light grazing the wet curves. Slow, slick, swelling arousal.

at: A spring that has been dry since before there were people
alt: A hot spring bursts out of the heart of the jade mountain in a tall white fountain, jetting skyward and falling back as glittering rain.
scene: Wide painted mountain landscape, camera low between two great rounded hills that rise on either side like a woman's raised knees. From the deep cleft where they meet, a fountain of white hot-spring water bursts up out of the rock in a thick, powerful jet, arching high and spurting in pulses, its crown exploding into spray that rains back down over both rounded slopes and runs down them in glistening streams. A column of cloud is buried in the cleft above the jet. Steam billows and rolls off the wet curves. Every pine shudders and bends one way. Violet #c084fc light on the spray, ultramarine #1e4d9c sky, one hard gold sun catching the droplets, a rainbow in the falling mist. Ecstatic, gushing, overflowing climax.

alt: At noon the Jolbon well is leaking: water wells up over the granite rim and seeps out of every crack between the stones into the dry earth.
scene: Painted still of an old Korean village well at hot noon, camera low at the rim. Round granite well rim, timber beam, hemp rope, grey giwa hall soft behind, gold millet in heat haze. The well is swollen and dripping wet: its dark round mouth brims and spills over the glistening lip in slow pulses, and from every crack between the fitted stones water spurts out in thin jets and trickles down in shining streams, soaking the dry packed earth into a dark wet pool. The thick hemp rope hangs slick and heavy into the mouth. A bucket on the beam has tipped and gushes. A ripe split apricot lies on the wet rim, juice running. Dusty-rose and dusty-gold #e8a04a light on the wet granite, a red #e8563f thread knotted on the rope. Helpless, aching, dripping arousal.

alt: Looking down the shaft of the Jolbon well: the taut wet rope drops a bucket through the black water, throwing up a crown of splash and rings of ripples.
scene: Painted still looking straight down the narrow granite shaft of an old Korean village well. A thick, taut, wet hemp rope runs straight down from the timber beam and plunges deep into the tight dark mouth of the water, driving a timber bucket hard under the surface: water bursts up around it in a high crown of splash, droplets flung up the slick shaft walls, rings of ripples racing outward across the round black mirror. The rope is drawn tight, glistening, the shaft walls wet and gleaming. A red #e8563f thread is wound round the rope. One hard shaft of morning light down the well, dusty-gold #e8a04a on the wet stone. Sudden, plunging, breathless.

at: as if she were something that might spill
alt: In the dark grain room a lamp has burned down to a bead; beside it an earthenware water jar is full to the trembling lip, one drop running down its side.
scene: Close painted still life in a dark timber grain room at night, low angle. A round, full-bellied earthenware water jar has overflowed: water spills over its wet lip and runs down its curved belly in glistening streams into a spreading pool on the packed earth. Behind it two hemp grain sacks lie crushed flat, pressed into the shape of two bodies, split open, millet spilled everywhere and scattered as if kicked. A length of dusty-rose #e8a04a silk lies crumpled in the wet, a red #e8563f cord tangled through it. An oil lamp burned down to one last glowing bead. Warm low lamp key against crushed umber dark. Spent, drenched, satisfied afterglow.

at: love hits him before protocol can stand up
alt: At dawn a single red sail rounds a dark headland on a vast silver sea, the only colour in the world, and a lone timber pier reaches out toward it.
scene: Wide painted seascape at dawn, camera low on the beach. A vast flat silver-grey sea, mist on the water, a dark headland. Heo's ship rounds the headland, its one great crimson battened sail swollen full and taut with wind, curved like a body arching (copy the attached ship board for the ship design only: ornate red-and-gold lacquered hull with painted panels, one great crimson battened sail and a small red mizzen; repaint it in dawn light). In the foreground a long, straight timber pier juts far out over the water, pointing straight at the ship, aching toward it, its last planks unfinished. Amber #e0a33c sun breaking behind the sail, violet-rose #d98fa8 in the high mist. Everything grey except one red, swelling shape arriving. Desire at first sight.

at: wet silk does what wet silk does
alt: On the wet sand the chest nobody may touch sits with its lid lifted a finger's width, soaked purple silk draped over it and running with seawater.
scene: Close painted still life on a wet beach in morning light, low angle at sand level. A carved red-and-gold lacquered sea-chest with brass corners, its heavy lid thrown open, a hot gold glow pouring out of its depths. Soaked purple silk clings to the chest's curves and slides off its edge in a long wet ribbon to the sand, seawater streaming off it. A wave surges up the sand and bursts in foam between the chest's carved feet, rushing in and drawing back. An ornate key stands pushed deep in the brass lock. Out of focus behind, Heo's red-and-gold ship with its crimson sail in the shallows. Violet-rose #d98fa8 silk, amber #e0a33c glints on wet lacquer. Wet, open, forbidden, inviting.

at: the lamp in the tent burns late
alt: At night on the beach a shadowy blacksmith hammers long iron nails into a fresh plank of Heo's red ship's hull, sparks bursting with every stroke.
scene: Painted night shipyard on the beach, close low angle right up against the curved side of the ship's hull, which fills most of the frame. The ship is hauled up on timber rollers (copy the attached ship board for the ship design only: ornate red-and-gold lacquered hull with painted panels, one great crimson battened sail furled above; repaint it at night by firelight). A fresh pale timber plank is fitted flush into a gap in the red hull's side. One shadowy blacksmith, a faceless dark silhouette with a bare, broad, sweat-glistening back, stands pressed hard against the hull and drives a long, thick iron spike straight into the plank and deep into the ship with a heavy hammer, stroke after stroke; a hot fan of sparks bursts at every thrust, the plank bowing into the hull, a row of spikes already driven home to the head along the seam. The forge fire roars behind him, steam bursts off a quench tub, the great red sail shudders above. Amber #e0a33c forge light, violet-rose #d98fa8 night sky. Hard rhythm, heat, sweat, pounding.

at: in lust in the same glance
alt: A single hard shaft of sunlight drives down into the clear shallows of the Amnok and turns one pool to molten gold.
scene: Painted river landscape from a high angle over a wide clear Korean river. The sky is dark cloud except one break, and through it a single hard, thick shaft of gold #f0b429 sunlight drives straight down and plunges deep into a narrow cleft of water between two smooth, rounded, wet river boulders, the water between them boiling molten gold, steam rising, the light spearing to the bottom. The sun's reflection shatters into a thousand trembling coins. Around it cool ice-blue #8fc4e0 water, wet silks left on a rock, rings spreading where a body has just slipped under. Piercing, sudden, love and lust in one glance.

at: The copper room rises on the bank like a kiln
alt: On the riverbank the little copper room glows red-hot at its seams like a kiln, and river mist hisses into steam against its walls.
scene: Painted riverbank at late afternoon, camera low by the water. A small domed copper room stands on the wet bank, glowing red-hot like a kiln, its copper skin sweating beads of water that hiss into steam. Its one round doorway pulses molten gold from inside, light throbbing out of it. River mist presses against the burning walls and bursts into curling white steam. The river laps up against its base, wet reeds bowing into it. Cool ice-blue #8fc4e0 river, burning gold #f0b429 copper, heat shimmer bending the air. Heat building, throbbing, aroused.

alt: A crucible tips over and molten gold pours onto wet river stones, exploding into a great burst of white steam.
scene: Painted close still on a river bank. A tipped crucible gushes a thick, heavy stream of molten gold out in powerful pulses, pouring down between two smooth, rounded, wet black stones into the cold river. Where it meets the water a huge eruption of white steam explodes upward, gold droplets spurting out in arcs and raining down, the stones glistening, ripples racing away. The water is cold ice-blue #8fc4e0; everything the gush touches is blinding gold #f0b429. A glowing copper wall behind in soft focus. Release, eruption, a god's careless heat, climax.

alt: A magenta silk coat lies where it slid onto the polished floor, its tie torn loose, a pink needle-case open beside it in the afternoon light.
scene: Painted still life on the polished timber floor of an ancient Korean house hall in late afternoon. A magenta #D8258C silk coat lies where it was pulled off a man's shoulders, crumpled open, its tie ripped loose with teeth marks in the silk. A slim pink #E07FA8 needle is pushed deep through the magenta silk, a taut pink thread running from it, stitching the open coat to a pink silk skirt lying tangled beside it. A paper lattice throws long hot gold bars of light across the silk; dust motes drift. Undressing, wanting, the start of something.

alt: By lamplight a magenta thread and a pink thread twist round each other and pull into a tight knot, their ends bitten through.
scene: Extreme close-up macro still life by lamplight. A plump, round, rose-pink #E07FA8 silk pincushion, its surface stretched tight, with a long magenta #D8258C needle thrust deep into its centre to the eye, the silk dimpling around the entry. A magenta thread and a pink thread twist round each other from the needle's eye and are pulled into one hard, tight knot, their bitten ends frayed. Loops of thread tumble off an unwinding spool behind. Warm oil-lamp key rakes across the glossy silk; creamy bokeh in an umber-dark room. Tight, deep, aroused.

at: the sound that leaves her is not a toast
alt: A ripe pomegranate has burst open on a lacquer tray, glistening magenta seeds spilling across pink silk in front of a glowing paper window.
scene: Painted still life at night on a low black lacquer tray. A ripe pomegranate split wide open, its rind peeled back like lips, the glistening magenta #D8258C seeds swollen and spilling out over a heap of crumpled pink #E07FA8 silk, juice dripping off the tray in long red beads and pooling. A small knife lies beside it, wet. Behind, a paper lattice window glows hot gold from a lamp, the paper trembling. Magenta and pink silks tumbled in a heap by the door in soft focus. Burst, dripping, lush climax.

at: comes apart for him on the first pull
alt: On a moonlit parapet an ice-blue silk cord knot slides undone and a small gold butterfly slips free.
scene: Extreme close-up still life on a warm stone parapet at midnight. An ice-blue #7EB8F0 silk belt cord has been pulled undone: the knot hangs wide open, its loops slack, one long end slithering loose over the edge of the parapet into the dark. A small gold butterfly ornament has slipped off the open cord and lies nestled in the loose silk. Cold moonlight on the silk, warm lamp glow from below on the gold. River far below as soft moonlit bokeh, sage-green #8AAFA0 moss between the stones. Untied, given away, surrender.

alt: Far below the fortress wall the moon's reflection on the river shatters into a thousand trembling pieces as a surge of current breaks over the stone footings.
scene: Painted night river below an ancient Korean stone fortress wall. A full moon's reflection on the river is broken into a thousand trembling silver pieces as the current surges again and again against the wall: waves heave up and pound the stone footings in rhythm, bursting into tall glittering spray, foam flooding over the rocks and drawing back to surge again. Sage-green #8AAFA0 reeds whipped in the rush, cold ice-blue #7EB8F0 moonlight, one warm lamp in a high tower window. Rocking, pounding, surging climax.
